test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The labelling for the parts a, b and c of the human respiratory system shown below are given as options. Identify the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1634de03d6d2469056fc45e21b686f7d0e31bbb9f9dc39e3471a2066af85d7dd.png]

options.text: a - Larynx, b - Pharynx, c - Trachea
a - Pharynx, b - Trachea, c - Larynx
a - Trachea, b - Larynx, c - Pharynx
a - Pharynx, b - Larynx, c - Trachea

solution:
The correct answer is **'__a - Pharynx, b - Larynx, c - Trachea__ '. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **network of tissues and organs called the respiratory system aids in breathing**. Together with **blood arteries,** it also has **airways and lungs**.
 
• The respiratory system **also includes the muscles that power the lungs**.
 
• In Human respiratory system, there are many parts like** Nose, Trachea, Larynx, Pharynx, wind pipe, Lungs, intrapulmonary bronchi, the bronchioles, and the alveolar ducts, etc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The airways can be categorised into two: the **upper airway systems and the lower airway systems**.
 
• The upper airway system comprises **the nose and the paranasal cavities (or ****sinuses), the pharynx (or throat), and partly also the oral cavity****,** since it may be used for breathing. 
 
• The **larynx, the trachea, the stem bronchi, and all airways deeply ramifying inside the lungs **make up the lower airway system.
